title: Modular by design

steps.label: Primary board
steps.body: The hub of every stack. It collects data from each board and connects over BLE and LoRaWAN.

steps.label: Sensor board
steps.body: Senses the space around it. Start with temperature, air quality, or motion, and add sensors as needs grow.

steps.label: Lock board
steps.body: Secures a door, parcel box, locker, or more. Motor drivers move the lock and cam switches confirm its position.

steps.label: Interaction board
steps.body: Connects the controls people touch and see. Mix and match buttons, lights, and screens.

steps.label: Power board
steps.body: Runs on batteries, wall power, or both, and powers every board in the stack.

note: Every board is optional and swappable. Configure the stack for each application, and extend it as needs grow.
